rows.text: 503 tasks pending. Now handling Task #113. Please do not disturb.
rows.speaker: "The Unviewable"

rows.text: Signs of life detected within the field of vision. Identification in progress... Identification successful... Chatting mode automatically activated.
rows.speaker: "The Unviewable"

rows.text: Welcome to the counseling and chatting function! What can I do for you?
rows.speaker: "The Unviewable"

rows.text: If you are just here for a chat, please be rest assured that the private mode has been activated. I'll provide a safe and private space for you.
rows.speaker: "The Unviewable"

rows.text: I'm designed to provide all kinds of services and support for the space station. Someone sent me here to fix a damaged area.
rows.speaker: "The Unviewable"

rows.text: No. My name is given by the logistics team.
rows.speaker: "The Unviewable"

rows.text: Are you inquiring about the robot naming feature? Space station researchers are authorized to change my name. Please update me after one natural month, or the changes will not take effect.
rows.speaker: "The Unviewable"

rows.text: What's the meaning of your name?
Oh, I see what you mean... Extracting video clip. Please wait...
rows.speaker: "The Unviewable"

rows.text: The little robot plays a video for you, showing several energetic creations of Ruan Mei trying to communicate with it. The robot, however, only mechanically repeats its cleaning task and did not respond.

After the little robot ignored the creations' request to interact for the 190th time, the creatures gave the Little Robot a name full of negative sentiments — The Unviewable — to "honor" how boring and rigid it was.
Glad to be at your service. See you next time.
rows.speaker: "The Unviewable"

rows.text: Beep... beep... The call has ended.
rows.speaker: "The Unviewable"

rows.text: The little robot gets busy again.
Currently busy. Please do not disturb. Please do not disturb.
rows.speaker: "The Unviewable"
